title: Link post frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter of content/links/*.md posts, matching themes/clean/archetypes/links.md and the fields consumed by themes/clean/layouts.

date.description: RFC3339 datetime, set automatically by `hugo new`.

site.description: Bare hostname of the linked site, e.g. `hackaday.com`

pub_date.description: Original publish date of the linked content. Rendered via time.Format in post/single.html so it must parse as a real date.

link_tags.description: Must be a YAML list of non-empty strings. Catches both a trailing comma (e.g. `[a, b,]`, which yields an empty extra element) and a bare unbracketed comma string (which fails the array type check).

formats.description: Must match the dropdown options in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/new-link.yml and the `formats` taxonomy.
